_doc: Requirements of Auscultrix 6.0 and the tests that verify them. The traceability matrix (docs/tecnico/tracciabilita.md) is generated from this file and the latest test run by tests/run-all.mjs. Origin: RF/RNF = thesis chapter 4; S/P/SC/NF = added by the 5.1 review; SND/VIS = added in 6.0.

requirements.text: Mood input: free text, six labelled chips, energy slider 0–100, optional photo analysed on the device.
Music database from documented sources; every track carries the provenance of its affective coordinates.
Playlist generated with the ISO principle: start on the declared state, shift gradually, only calibrated tracks on the mood-matched path.
Playback on YouTube in a tab opened by the extension.

Auto-advance at the end of the track, only in the session's own player tab and only for the video Auscultrix put there: a video the person picks in that tab is theirs (no advance, YouTube's autoplay carries on, the panel shows the playlist paused, ▶ resumes).
Vision overlay at 3 fps with slow cross-fades and duration-linked zoom, only on the session's own video in its own tab (never in the person's other YouTube tabs or on a video they choose).
Interface in Italian and English with identical keys and placeholders.
Wellbeing notice at first run with help resources (IASP, 112, Telefono Amico) and «don't show again».
Local user model: numbers and labels only, last 60 sessions, visible and erasable.
Comforting media (books, films) proposed after the mood analysis.
«Choose for me» disabled until there is mood input.
Read-aloud of the analysis with a local voice (never throws).
At the end of the playlist the session closes; it never jumps back to the first track.
The player tab's video ids are read safely from every YouTube URL form; session video state is kept in memory only and cleared with the session.
Crisis words: help first, no autoplay, nothing opened on the person's behalf, crisis-appropriate copy.
Substance words: national addiction line offered; music still available; its opening days are shown.
No request for donations after a session where help was shown, nor to minors.
Minors: no film, series or game without a verified age rating.
Photosensitive safety: ≤ 3 flashes/s, no red flashes; in SAFE mode opacity × luminance step < 0.10.
The person's own tabs are never navigated or driven by the extension, also after a browser restart.
Vision: an explicit «off» is respected; never switched on by itself with «reduce motion».
Everyday expressions do not raise false alarms.
Typed text and photo never written to disk; crisis level kept in memory only.
«Forget everything» removes every personal key and the session state.
No transmission of what the person writes; no Apple/Deezer lookups; no telemetry.
Lyrics lookup (lrclib.net) only after explicit consent.
Minimal permissions and host permissions.
Every stored key is inventoried with its purpose.
Read-aloud uses only voices that run on the device; with none for the language it stays off and says why (a network voice would send the mood reading online).
Works offline with the bundled catalogues; no error shown when services are unreachable.
Playlist and settings persist across browser restarts.
Service-worker suspension does not lose the session nor the player tab.
Rapid repeated actions do not duplicate sessions or corrupt state.
Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA subset): names, alt text, contrast, target size ≥ 24 px, keyboard, dialogs.
Performance budgets: panel ready < 3 s, session < 1.5 s, heap growth < 25 MB/20 sessions, storage < 5 MB.
Security: CSP with packaged scripts only, no unsafe DOM sinks or dynamic code, no plain-http endpoints.
Release integrity: all code parses, versions consistent, Firefox manifest derived correctly.
No accumulation of observers/intervals on YouTube single-page navigation.
No credential ships in the package: the build refuses Spotify client secrets, refresh tokens and key files.
Energy formula as documented (worked example «Tutti» = 0.584; ordinal validity).
Vision zoom peaks at mid-track for any duration; symmetric; baseline at ends.
Lyrics fusion bounded (≤ 35 % valence, ≤ 15 % energy), pure function.
ISO target bounded (Euclidean ≤ 0.3) and never opposite to the start.
In-house regression gates for the affect engine (development and held-out sets).
Personalisation prior moves the declared state by at most 0.08.
Variety: max 3 tracks per artist, novelty across sessions, empty places handled.
Valence never inferred from popularity.
Generative soundscape computed on the device, following the same ISO trajectory as the playlist (start on the declared state, shift, hold).
Affect-to-sound mapping uses documented musical cues; every driven parameter is listed with its mapping type and source.
Hearing and comfort safety: bounded event rate, slow modulation, fades ≥ 6–8 s, 40 Hz–12 kHz band, limiter, peak ≤ −1 dBFS, quiet loudness at the default volume.
Stochastic structure: non-homogeneous Poisson events at the requested rate; stepwise Markov melody within the current mode; no mode flapping.
Reproducible exports: 16-bit WAV with dither, JSON score, Pure Data vanilla twin that opens without errors.
Measurement tools are correct on known signals (ITU-R BS.1770-4 loudness, spectral centroid, onset detection).
Soundscape preferences are inventoried and erased by «Forget everything»; in a crisis the soundscape never starts by itself.
Diary map: past sessions drawn on the valence–arousal plane with a text and table alternative; no trend line, no health claim.
